evals.name: signed-amount-with-balance-column
evals.prompt: Run check_result on MST 052300008705 for 2026.Q2. The bank statement has a 'Số dư sau giao dịch (VND)' column with signed amounts (positive = inflow, negative = outflow). Validate the running balance consistency.
evals.expected_output: Should detect the balance column, verify running balances for all rows, and report whether all balances are consistent or list any discrepancies.

evals.name: debit-credit-format-with-balance-column
evals.prompt: Run check_result on MST 033198001673 for 2026.Q2. The bank statement has a 'Số dư sau giao dịch (VNĐ)' column with separate debit/credit columns. Validate the running balance consistency.
evals.expected_output: Should detect the balance column, identify debit and credit columns, verify running balances, and report results.

evals.name: no-balance-column
evals.prompt: Run check_result on MST 8307704000-002 for 2026.Q2. The bank statement has NO balance column (only STT, Ngày & Giờ, Mã giao dịch, Số tiền, Phí). Verify that check 3.7 correctly reports 'Skipped'.
evals.expected_output: Should report 'ℹ️ Skipped — no balance column found in bank statement' for check 3.7.
